content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

The infrastructure for selling music online without conventional payment methods focuses on blockchain and cryptocurrency as the backbone of commerce. This ecosystem provides digital creators with autonomy and direct access to their sales. Unlike platforms such as Gumroad, which charge significant commission fees—10% on every sale—using solutions like NOWPayments reduces transaction fees to just 0.5%. This difference can significantly impact your bottom line, allowing you to keep more of your earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for your online music store includes several key components that work seamlessly together. At the front end, you can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your site for free. On the back end, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manages payment processing and order fulfillment. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments verifies transactions on-chain, ensuring you receive payment in Bitcoin without needing a buyer account. This setup guarantees that you own all your data and the entire operation functions without third-party interference.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is tailored for digital creators who face barriers when using traditional payment platforms. If you’re an artist, musician, or content creator based in areas like Ghana or Pakistan, this solution provides an accessible way to monetize your work. By adopting cryptocurrency for transactions, you gain financial sovereignty, enabling you to engage with a global audience without the constraints of geographic limitations imposed by conventional payment processors.
Cut your transaction fees from 10% to just 0.5% with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components that enable this infrastructure include hosting services like GitHub Pages, backend solutions like Cloudflare Workers, and payment processing through NOWPayments. When combined, these tools create an efficient system for selling digital music. Your products are stored on platforms like Google Drive for immediate access, and your sales data is securely handled through Supabase or Google Sheets. This architecture not only provides a low-cost way to operate but also ensures that you have complete ownership of your assets.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by setting up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing. Integrate NOWPayments to support Bitcoin transactions and set up your product delivery through Google Drive. Once everything is in place, you can promote your music and start selling immediately. For a comprehensive guide to deploying your online store, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) — it includes all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign stack for your digital commerce. This architecture leverages blockchain technology and services like NOWPayments for payment processing, allowing you to accept Bitcoin directly. It simplifies the selling process while ensuring you retain complete ownership of your products and data.
Own your data and your customer relationships — no third-party platforms involved.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore how the Complete Builder Kit ($197) equips you with everything you need. This kit includes essential blueprints and templates to build your digital store on a sovereign stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information on how you can start making sales without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without Gumroad or Payhip by setting up your own shop using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, combined with NOWPayments for payment processing.

Using cryptocurrency for transactions reduces fees significantly compared to traditional platforms, offering lower transaction costs and immediate settlement. This means more revenue for creators.
How do I ensure my customers receive their digital products?
To ensure customers receive their digital products, integrate automated delivery systems through Google Drive or Cloudflare Workers, which will provide instant access upon purchase confirmation.
